checks: Exact named tests in native-commands.json; paired source syntax
cost: Path assembly O(environment string bytes), allocation proportional to returned path. Module declarations have compile/representation evidence only; no runtime codec cost is implied.
description: Publishes layer modules and conditionally test module. model_path reads MOVA_DATA; absent or non-Unicode value falls back to HOME plus /mova-data, then appends en/models/en.bin.
forward: Publishes layer modules and conditionally test module. model_path reads MOVA_DATA; absent or non-Unicode value falls back to HOME plus /mova-data, then appends en/models/en.bin.
inverse: A resulting PathBuf admits different environment assignments: explicit MOVA_DATA and fallback HOME can yield same path. No unique environment or model contents can be recovered from the path.
model_path performs no existence check, file open, model load or directory creation. Exports do not themselves run a roundtrip.
limitations: No annotator/model loading, live corpus, full suite, teacher, GPU or persistent-learning evidence. No executable percentage surrogate: categorical codecs/effects need a useful metric before future caps 1/2/5/10%.
state: Layer representations, diagnostic residuals and fixed environment state; see scoped catalog.
